spec.title: Next steps spec (JSON)
spec.description: JSON describing the proposed next steps: optional title/subtitle, a 'badges' array (label, variant), an optional summary callout (showSummary, summaryTitle, summaryDetail), and a 'steps' array where each step has a 'title' plus optional detail, rationale, iconName, iconColor, priorityLabel, priorityVariant, meta line and a per-step link (showCta, ctaLabel, ctaUrl). Leave blank to render a portable demo plan.
